## Tests

- [ ] `bundle exec rake test` passes
- [ ] New behaviour has a test that fails without the change

Changes to signature verification, token claims or subject validation need a
test that fails against the current code. State which test and how it fails.

## Compatibility

- [ ] No change to a public method's signature, or the change is additive
- [ ] No change to what is accepted on the wire, or the change accepts both
